name: Bromelain
summary: Post-exercise soreness context; protein digestion support; safety screen: pineapple allergy; anticoagulants; planned surgery.
description: Bromelain is a proteolytic mixture with mechanistic interest in inflammatory mediators and digestion support; evidence strength varies by outcome.
safetyNotes: Bleeding/allergy considerations matter; avoid around surgery unless clinician-directed.
